description: Source code implementing a three-way merge algorithm for Git, including functions for merging trees, handling merge options, and displaying merge results.

methods.name: add_merge_entry
methods.description: Adds a merge_list entry to the global merge_result list.

methods.name: trivial_merge_trees
methods.description: Performs a trivial merge of three trees based on a common base.

methods.name: explanation
methods.description: Returns a string explanation of the merge stage for a given merge_list entry.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Generates the merged blob object for a given merge_list entry.

methods.name: origin
methods.description: Retrieves the original object for a merge_list entry.

methods.name: show_outf
methods.description: Outputs diff buffer lines to stdout.

methods.name: show_diff
methods.description: Displays the diff between the base and merged blobs for a merge_list entry.

methods.name: show_result_list
methods.description: Displays the merge result list with explanations.

methods.name: show_result
methods.description: Iterates over all merge results and displays them.

methods.name: same_entry
methods.description: Checks if two name_entry objects are the same.

methods.name: both_empty
methods.description: Checks if two name_entry objects are both empty (null OID).

methods.name: create_entry
methods.description: Creates a new merge_list entry with specified stage, mode, oid, and path.

methods.name: traverse_path
methods.description: Constructs a traversal path string for a name_entry.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a merge conflict for a given path and entries.

methods.name: unresolved_directory
methods.description: Handles unresolved directory merges by filling tree descriptors and performing a trivial merge.

methods.name: link_entry
methods.description: Links a name_entry into a merge_list with a specified stage.

methods.name: unresolved
methods.description: Handles unresolved merge conflicts for three-way merge.

methods.name: threeway_callback
methods.description: Callback function for traversing trees during a three-way merge, handling conflicts and merges.

methods.name: trivial_merge
methods.description: Performs a trivial merge of three trees given base, branch1, and branch2.

methods.name: real_merge
methods.description: Performs a real (non-trivial) merge of two branches with optional merge base, handling conflicts and output.

methods.name: cmd_merge_tree
methods.description: Main command function to perform merge-tree operations based on CLI arguments and options.
